meta.title: Booking, quotes and price requests · YukSaroy
meta.description: Book a terminal spot, get a price from an open formula, send a request to an equipment owner: three paths, one cabinet. Live tariff example and today's free spots.

booking.title: Book. Quote. Ask a price.
booking.lead: A terminal service gets a booked spot, the price comes from an open formula, equipment and truck listings take a request to the owner. All three live in one cabinet.

facts.freeSlots: {count, plural, one {# free spot today} other {# free spots today}}
facts.sidings: {count, plural, one {# siding} other {# sidings}} in the registry

book.title: Book
book.body: Pick a terminal window for today or the coming days. The spot is held for 10 minutes, the tariff is frozen once the order is sent. The terminal confirms or rejects within the SLA.

quote.title: Quote
quote.body: The price is calculated without logging in: tariff × weight or wagon count + extra services. If the terminal set a minimum amount, it is shown too. Commission is 0 % in the pilot.

ask.title: Ask a price
ask.body: For equipment and truck listings the price is agreed with the owner. The request goes from the cabinet, the owner's phone is visible only to logged-in users.

example.heading: Live example: how a tariff adds up
example.lead: Using the current tariffs of {terminal}: {weight} t of cargo, 1 wagon, loading and weighing.
example.note: When you place an order this tariff is frozen and shown on the act. A tariff from a passport not confirmed by the owner is an estimate.
example.empty: No active terminal has published a tariff yet. The example appears here once a terminal owner adds one.

slots.heading: Free spots: {terminal}
slots.none: No open spots in the next 14 days. The terminal opens spots from its cabinet.
slots.notToday: No spots opened for today, the nearest open day is shown.

chain.heading: Order state chain
chain.lead: The terminal marks each step in its cabinet, you see it on the order page. Every mark is timestamped, leaving no room for disputes.

ARRIVED.title: Arrived
ARRIVED.body: Wagon at the terminal, spot time started

WEIGHED.title: Weighed
WEIGHED.body: Scale result written to the order

band.title: Start with terminals that have a free spot today
band.body: The catalog shows only terminals with an open window today. Booking needs a cabinet, the price calculator does not.
